description: Change up to 200 contracts in ONE call: per item { contract_id, account_id?, contact_id?, our_account_id?, our_role?, status?, counterparty_name?, contract_type?, custom_values?: { key: value } }. Each item goes through update_contract and set_custom_values, so the same rights, field rights, approvals and history apply as for single calls. One bad item does not stop the others. Returns { ok, failed, errors: [{contract_id, error}] } — no records, so it stays small.

items.description: Up to 200 changes, each { contract_id, ... } with the fields to set

contract_type.description: Contract type, e.g. rental, service, maintenance, lease, insurance

counterparty_name.description: Name of the counterparty as text

custom_values.description: Custom field values { key: value }, set via set_custom_values

our_role.description: Our role in the contract, e.g. customer, provider, landlord, tenant, partner, other

status.description: New contract status, e.g. draft, active, terminated, expired, archived

name: bulk_update_contracts
